Subject: SOC 2 evidence handoff + live walkthrough window

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting our SOC 2 scoping and would like to schedule the live evidence walkthrough and network overview with your team. Two requests from our side:

1) A short (30–45m) walkthrough where your engineering/security team can share the service architecture, data flows, and how tokens/keys are managed.
2) Access to the SOC 2 evidence bundle (control mappings, policy docs, and a network diagram) ahead of the call so we can prep questions.

Proposed time windows (PST):
- Tue Mar 23 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed Mar 24 — 08:30–09:15 or 14:00–14:45

We can accept materials via a secure Drive folder (share link) or a temporary S3 presigned link. I attached our NDA if you prefer to sign first.

Attachments: nimbus-nda-template.pdf

Let me know which slot works and whether you prefer Drive or S3 for the evidence handoff.

Thanks,
Marc Lane
Information Security Manager
Nimbus Health
